'''Nemen Ull''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]] around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Ull and his [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Wamtra]] were [[Battle of Argul|deployed]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]], where they [[Ground warfare/Legends|held off]] [[Legion/Legends|legions]] of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] while the native [[Argullian]]s evacuated from the world. During the battle, Ull entered an [[Unidentified Argullian apartment complex|apartment complex]] to search for a [[Unidentified Argullian child|missing child]], and he [[Death/Legends|died]] when the building was shelled by Confederate [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]].

==Biography==
[[File:Jedi_symbol.svg|thumb|left|200px|Nemen Ull served in the Jedi Order (emblem pictured) during the Republic Era.]]
Nemen Ull was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Ull eventually attained the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Wamtra]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]].<ref name="Only the Force" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] was plunged into conflict following the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Only the Force" /> Around the first [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the conflict,<ref name="date" /> shortly after the [[Battle of Mon Calamari (Clone Wars)/Legends|Battle of Mon Calamari]], the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]] fell under [[Battle of Argul|attack]] from Confederate forces, and the Republic leader [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] called for an evacuation of the world's [[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="Only the Force" />

Ull and Wamtra journeyed to Argul to aid the withdrawal, and they were tasked with [[Ground warfare/Legends|fending off]] the attacking Confederate [[Army/Legends|army]] for long enough to allow the native [[Argullian]]s to reach the planet's [[Hangar/Legends|docking towers]]. For [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]], the two Jedi held back [[Legion/Legends|legions]] of Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], and their actions created a window of opportunity for the Argullians to transfer their sick and wounded to the docking towers and flee the world, saving countless lives. However, after Ull entered an [[Unidentified Argullian apartment complex|apartment complex]] to search for a [[Unidentified Argullian child|missing child]], the building was shelled by Confederate [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tanks]] and was destroyed, resulting in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the Jedi Master. In the aftermath of Ull's demise, Wamtra struggled to cope with the loss of his mentor, becoming distraught and withdrawn; he wondered whether he should have gone into the apartment complex in Ull's place, and even considered resigning from the Jedi Order.<ref name="Only the Force" />

==Personality and traits==
Nemen Ull was willing to sacrifice his life while attempting to save a child during the fighting on Argul. He had a close relationship with his apprentice, and Wamtra was overwhelmed with grief as a result of the loss of his Master.<ref name="Only the Force" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nemen Ull was mentioned in ''[[Only the Force]]'', a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] adventure that was written by [[J.D. Wiker]] and published in [[2004]].<ref name="Only the Force" />
